candidates.description: Persistent multiplayer for RimWorld 1.7: dedicated servers, shared colonies, async and live raids, escrow trading, auctions, delivery contracts, alliances, a web admin panel and a Discord bot.
candidates.readme_excerpt:
Version **0.9.2** includes the passive-outpost implementation with Product qualification **Pending** and the capability disabled. Real two-client G1–G7 acceptance and the final branch review are complete; the seven required fixes have been verified. These checks retain their actual source/build boundaries and do not qualify the release build for Product activation. Administrative readiness and isolated acceptance are described in the [EN](wiki/en/admins/passive-outposts.md) and [RU](wiki/ru/admins/passive-outposts.md) Wiki sources. Update the server and client mod together. The server and CLI require the qualified .NET and ASP.NET runtime **10.0.14**; source builds use SDK **10.0.403**. The packaged runtime policy requires this patch explicitly. Keep original executors and runtime installations for unfinished frozen restore plans; see the [server setup](docs/server-setup.md).

Rimlink is persistent multiplayer for RimWorld 1.7. Players run their own colonies on one planet shared through a dedicated server, and can also join a friend's colony to control the pawns assigned to them. A colony is frozen while its owner is offline, so a group can trade and send raids without being online at the same time; when both players are online, they can visit, raid or manage a colony together live. Rimlink is a clean-room project with its own protocol, server and client. It shares no code with other RimWorld multiplayer mods and does not work with them. ## What's new in 0.8.1 [Release 0.8.1](https://github.com/Asofwar/rimlink/releases/tag/v0.8.1) keeps transfers and deliveries tied to the exact saved colony, including two saves on the same game tick. Uploads use immutable files in order; an administrative save rollback fences off the previously loaded colony. Mailbox, raids and live-session recovery continue independently when trading is frozen. Ambiguous interrupted transfers are preserved for manual recovery instead of being replayed or returned speculatively. Update the server and mod together. See the [verification report](docs/verification/2026-11-03-recovery-correctness.md) for the completed checks and remaining limits. ## What's new in 0.8.0 [Release 0.8.0](https://github.com/Asofwar/rimlink/releases/tag/v0.8.0) adds [guild influence on the world map](docs/guild-influence.md): voluntary publication, offline sources, guild colors, a legend and hatched disputed tiles. Influence changes no colony ownership or attack rights. [Server-hosted modpack delivery](docs/modpack-delivery.md) downloads a prepared redistributable collection without Steam, checks it, installs it with rollback and enables it after one restart. The administrator must publish the package and permit password login for GOG players; Core and DLC come from the player's own game.
